subject: POC: Hands-on kickoff — prep questionnaire, agenda draft & slot swap
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: POC kickoff — first pass agenda + prep questionnaire

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for agreeing to a hands-on POC with Acme. Attached is a first-pass agenda and a short prework questionnaire so we can prioritize the hands-on time:

- 30 min: rollcall & success criteria alignment
- 90 min: guided prompt review and prompt-to-routing mapping
- 45 min: live routing & inference demos (fallback policy, variant routing)
- 45 min: load test run (small scale) + observations
- 30 min: next steps & mutual action plan

Prep asks (in the Prework-Questionnaire.docx):
- Share 3 representative prompt templates and expected responses
- Provide sample request volume (qps) and typical sequence lengths for peak/baseline
- Confirm if there are region/network restrictions and where we can run short load tests
- Add names for any additional attendees who must be present for routing decisions

Attachments: POC-Agenda-v0.9.pdf, Prework-Questionnaire.docx, LoadTest-SamplePayloads.jsonl

Can you confirm 60–75 min windows on either: Tue 11/23 09:00–10:15 PT or Thu 11/25 11:00–12:15 PT? We can expand to the full schedule once we lock the slot. If neither works, propose two windows and we’ll reshuffle.

Thanks — Rafael
--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@acme.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procure Team <procure@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — first pass agenda + prep questionnaire

Hi Rafael — thanks for the detailed agenda and the questionnaire. This looks good. A couple of notes/questions before we lock a time: 

1) Conflict: the Tue 11/23 slot collides with a leadership offsite; Thu 11/25 at 11:00 PT is better but I need to confirm with Jordan in infra. Can we also consider Mon 11/22 10:00–11:15 PT as an alternative?

2) Load tests: will Redwood run the load tests from your hosted infra or do you want us to provide access to a staging endpoint? We typically prefer vendor-run tests inside our VPC for throughput/latency realism — will that require an access request?

3) Prompt review: who on your side will lead the prompt dry-run? We’ll try to get our prompt author (Samir) on the call.

I’ll get back within the day with a firm slot.

Best,
Elena
Director, Product — Acme Corp
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morgan <elena.morgan@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — first pass agenda + prep questionnaire

Hi Elena — quick answers: 

- Mon 11/22 10:00–11:15 PT works for us. Let’s tentatively hold that and we’ll finalize when you confirm.

- Load tests: Redwood can run a scoped load run either from our hosted environment or inside your VPC depending on what you prefer. For a VPC run we’ll need a short-lived IAM/service-account access and a one-hour window to push ~200–500 RPS for a short burst (we’ll only run what you authorize). If you prefer not to open inbound testing, we can run the same payloads from our region to simulate latency/cost and report back metrics. The LoadTest-SamplePayloads.jsonl file shows the distribution we intend to use.

- Prompt dry-run: Marissa Cole (cc’d) will lead the prompt review and pilot routing mapping. Ben Carter will be the overall CS backup. Marissa — can you review the prompt set, run the dry-run, and attach a short report (prompt-responses.csv) before Monday so Rafael/Elena can review?

Attachments/links we’ll push to the shared Drive: agenda, prework, runbook. Also attaching an Environment-Access-Checklist.xlsx that outlines the minimum access items we’ll need for an in-VPC test.

Thanks — looking forward. If Mon is firm we’ll update the calendar invite and include the runbook.

— Rafael
--
Rafael Mendes
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Thanks Rafael / Elena — confirming Mon 11/22 10:00–11:15 PT is locked on our side and I’ll run the prompt dry-run tomorrow morning and share findings by EOD: 

Checklist of what I’ll deliver before the session:
- Prompt-run dry-run notes (prompt-responses.csv)
- Routing mapping proposal (which prompt -> model variant -> fallback)
- Small-scope load test plan and safety guardrails (we’ll only execute after you sign off)
- Slide deck for the hands-on lab (POC-Agenda-v0.9.pdf updated to v1.0)

I’ve attached the Prompt-Runbook.md and the Environment-Access-Checklist.xlsx. If you can confirm who will provide staging access (if we’re doing VPC tests), I’ll produce the exact commands we’ll execute and the temporary account window we need.

See you Monday — Marissa
